publication_invariants: One shared execution path for CLI, API, schedule and compatibility wrappers.
Run-scoped immutable staging; validate all requested datasets before any success claim.
Preserve signed market release semantics; an orchestration manifest cannot confer provenance authority.
Manifest pointer consistency requires reader migration; otherwise only per-dataset atomicity is claimed.
SQLite and filesystem are not one transaction; reconcile prepared and published states against manifest hashes.
Only a live lock owner with the current fencing token can publish; stale workers cannot overwrite a newer generation.
Checkpoint after durable output; bind resume to code, config, schema, input, universe and source versions.
Rollback disables scheduling and switches validated pointers under the same lock; never replay committed writes.
Strict PIT eligibility requires as_of <= available_at <= decision_time; missing historical availability remains unverified.
Exact cutoff equality accepted; ingestion time cannot be backdated to manufacture historical knowledge.

1: Reject None/empty/string/list payloads, booleans as integers, NaN, Inf, -Inf, bounds and unknown fields before mutation.
2: Reject directories, traversal, symlinks/reparse roots and malformed UTF-8; reject BOM/duplicate JSON keys; preserve documented CRLF input policy and LF artifacts.
3: Corrupt, duplicate, truncated and cross-run checkpoint shards fail hash/schema/input binding checks before resume writes.
4: Provider/validation/publication failure never returns pipeline success; CLI nonzero and durable failed or cancelled state.
5: Inject write, flush, fsync, replace, pointer and cleanup failure; preserve last-known-good and reconcile ambiguous commits.
6: Reject future availability and naive timestamps; inclusive cutoff; derived availability maximum; live caller input never inherits signed historical provenance.
7: Vietnam holidays, weekends, 15:29:59/15:30:00/15:30:01 ICT, source-specific close and delayed publication, missing calendar coverage.
8: Reject finite arithmetic overflow, zero/negative denominators, oversized integers above supported domain; do not globally ban legitimate large VND balances.
9: Simultaneous manual/scheduled/legacy dispatch, lock timeout, lease expiry and stale publisher fenced; worker isolation and cancellation race.
10: Normalize known provider thousand-VND scale once; explicit VND_FULL metadata; legitimate sub-1000 Dong price not rejected by heuristic.
11: Historical delisted/suspended/new listings, PIT universe changes and lifecycle receipt failure; no current-only universe substitution.
12: Reject shell strings, flag smuggling, path/URL injection and invalid tickers; fixed command arrays, no shell=True.
13: Strict versioned dataset schemas; extra/missing/renamed columns, duplicate keys and incorrect types fail before publication.
14: Bound request range, symbols, workers, provider bytes, checkpoint sizes, log tails, pages and memory; stream partitions.
15: Timeout and 429 exhaust finite attempts/deadline; injected clock, cancellation and Retry-After cap, no real sleep loops.
16: Secrets/userinfo/query tokens redacted in persisted errors, logs, manifests and provider failure artifacts.
17: Plan package binds integer role 15 and low risk; retain standing JEV role/risk/cycle validation suites unchanged.
18: Advisor model exactly cx/gpt-6-astra; do not change routing catalog or cross-tier allowlists.
19: Gate/session/role/risk/idempotency and actor binding; reject wrong-run resume, replay and cross-user operation.
20: Graph/contract/source/advisor hashes and strict duplicate-key parsing; tampered manifests fail before use.
21: Fsync/atomic-replace/durability fault injection for future run publication; retain advisor decision durability regression suites.
22: Lock ownership, live/stale owner checks, concurrent publisher isolation; retain standing decision-lock regressions.
23: Bound provider retry; no silent provider/fallback provenance upgrade; advisor fallback unchanged and low-risk only.
24: Secret-safe task prompts, no auth material requested or printed, advisory-only receipts, URL redaction standing regressions.
